prediction.rationale:

Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.39 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.88 s (within 1% of healthy). Sharp pressure transient and immediate switching between sensors indicate optimal valve response.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.64 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 368 W·min/l (4% below healthy). Flow delivery and motor electrical consumption match expected volumetric efficiency without leakage.
Accumulator: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 46.3 bar (within 1% of healthy). Hydraulic accumulator effectively dampens load transients with normal pre-charge.
